title: Supercharging Olmo-core for Efficient and Scalable MoE Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.18956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models add parameters without proportionally increasing per-token compute. However, training cost also depends on bytes moved, memory held, and kernels launched, and many of those costs follow total parameter size rather than active compute. On infrastructure built for dense models, this mismatch is costly: in early baselines, throughput fell as stored expert parameter size grew, even though the useful work per token stayed nearly fixed. To close this gap, we present a redesigned training stack in Olmo-core, built for efficient, scalable MoE training. We replace the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) of earlier Olmo-core versions with an architecture built on Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and add Expert Parallelism (EP), Pipeline Parallelism (PP), a distributed optimizer, and activation recompute. translated_title: 为高效且可扩展的 MoE 训练全面强化 Olmo-core
translated_abstract: 专家混合模型在不按比例增加每 token 计算量的前提下增加参数。然而，训练成本还取决于传输的字节数、占用的内存以及启动的内核数量，而这些成本中有许多是随总参数规模而非活跃计算量增长的。在为稠密模型构建的基础设施上，这种不匹配的代价很高：在早期基线中，随着存储的专家参数规模增大，吞吐量反而下降，尽管每 token 的有效工作量几乎保持不变。为了弥合这一差距，我们在 Olmo-core 中重新设计了训练栈，以实现高效、可扩展的 MoE 训练。我们将早期 Olmo-core 版本中的全分片数据并行（FSDP）替换为基于分布式数据并行（DDP）构建的架构，并引入了专家并行（EP）、流水线并行（PP）、分布式优化器以及激活重计算。我们提出了基于 NVSHMEM 的逐行专家并行，它将每个 token 直接写入其对应专家的缓冲区，避免了分发操作……
tldr: 该工作重新设计了 Olmo-core 训练栈——以基于 DDP 的架构取代 FSDP，并引入专家并行、流水线并行、分布式优化器和基于 NVSHMEM 的逐行专家并行——从而实现高效且可扩展的 MoE 训练。
en_tdlr: This work redesigns the Olmo-core training stack—replacing FSDP with a DDP-based architecture and adding expert parallelism, pipeline parallelism, a distributed optimizer, and NVSHMEM-based rowwise expert parallelism—to enable efficient and scalable MoE training.
